subtitle: "Visual checklist covering all required output types for RevealJS"
format:
  auto-dark-clean-revealjs:
    slide-number: true
execute:
  echo: false

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

auto_dark_setup <- c(
  "../../_extensions/thomashusson29/auto-dark/auto-dark-setup.R",
  "../../_extensions/auto-dark/auto-dark-setup.R",
  "../_extensions/auto-dark/auto-dark-setup.R"
)
auto_dark_setup <- auto_dark_setup[file.exists(auto_dark_setup)]
if (!length(auto_dark_setup)) {
  stop("Cannot find auto-dark-setup.R. Adjust the path for your project layout.")
}
source(auto_dark_setup[[1]])
auto_dark_on()

library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
if (requireNamespace("gtsummary", quietly = TRUE)) library(gtsummary)
```

## Test 1 — ggplot2 {.center}

```{r}
#| label: fig-ggplot2
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: "90%"
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Weight", y = "MPG", colour = "Cyl") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

*Expected: transparent background; One Dark slide bg visible behind plot.*

---

## Test 2 — Base R plot

```{r}
#| label: fig-base-r
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| out-width: "80%"
plot(
  mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg,
  pch = 19, col = "#2A6F97",
  xlab = "Weight", ylab = "MPG",
  main = "Base R — mtcars"
)
abline(lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars), col = "#e06c75", lwd = 2)
```

---

## Test 3 — Transparent background

```{r}
#| label: fig-transparent
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
#| out-width: "80%"
op <- par(bg = "transparent", mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
curve(sin(x), from = -pi, to = 2 * pi,
      col = "#61afef", lwd = 2,
      xlab = "x", ylab = "sin(x)",
      main = "Transparent background test")
abline(h = 0, col = "#3e4451", lty = 2)
par(op)
```

*Slide background must be visible behind the axes.*

---

## Test 4 — gt table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gt
head(mtcars[, c("mpg", "cyl", "wt", "am")], 6) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "mtcars sample")
```

---

## Test 5 — gtsummary

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gtsummary
if (requireNamespace("gtsummary", quietly = TRUE)) {
  gtsummary::trial |>
    dplyr::select(age, grade, trt) |>
    gtsummary::tbl_summary(by = trt, missing = "no") |>
    gtsummary::add_p() |>
    gtsummary::as_gt()
} else {
  cat("gtsummary not installed — skipped.")
}
```

---

## Test 6 — Local image via include_graphics()

```{r}
#| label: make-local-png
#| include: false
dir.create("generated", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
local_img <- "generated/test-revealjs-image.png"

png(local_img, width = 700, height = 300, res = 100, bg = "white")
par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
plot(pressure, type = "b", pch = 19, col = "#2A6F97",
     xlab = "Temperature", ylab = "Pressure",
     main = "Local PNG — include_graphics() in RevealJS")
grid(col = "#dddddd")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-include-graphics
#| out-width: "70%"
knitr::include_graphics(local_img)
```

*Dark companion must be generated and shown in dark mode.*

## Test 9 — Markdown table

| Element          | Dark mode expectation                |
|------------------|--------------------------------------|
| Slide background | `#282c34`                            |
| Plot background  | Transparent (slide bg visible)       |
| gt tables        | Dark bg, light text                  |
| Code blocks      | One Dark panel bg                    |
| ☾/☀ button       | Top-right; persists across reloads   |

## Test 10 — RevealJS presentation (this document)

The ☾/☀ button in the top-right corner should:

- Toggle between dark and light mode
- Persist the choice in `localStorage`
- Start in the correct mode on reload (OS preference or last choice)

> Use your browser developer tools to confirm `html.auto-dark-theme-dark` is
> present in dark mode.
